items.text:
Udi, I suggest we pause computation and decide what “balanced” should mean.

The current 100-cell snapshot has loads **0–105**, with **12 empty cells**. The median stopping rule can tolerate large differences in part of the map, so reaching 5% would not make every region balanced.

The central choice is: **must the partition cover the whole island, including the northern areas with almost no pickups, or only the area where pickups occur?** Keeping full coverage and compact cells limits how evenly we can distribute demand.

Which matters more to you: full geographical coverage or balanced pickup loads?
